remarks: Highly sought-after Leefair end unit offering true ranch-style living with exceptional privacy and a first-floor layout designed for comfort and convenience. This 4-bedroom, 3.5 bath home features a first-floor primary suite plus an additional first-floor bedroom with its own full bath-ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or a private office suite. The second floor adds two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and a generous sitting room that creates a perfect retreat for guests, teens, or flexible bonus space. The main level enjoys garden and patio views, with three separate entrance points and direct terrace access from both the living room and the primary suite. The living room stands out with coffered ceilings, soaring height, abundant natural light, and custom built-ins that elevate both style and functionality. A spacious two-car garage with built-in cabinetry offers organized storage, and a brand-new AC system ensures year-round comfort. Set within the coveted Leefair community-known for its convenience, beautifully maintained grounds, and low maintenance lifestyle-this end unit presents a rare opportunity to enjoy generous square footage, thoughtful design, and a premier in-town location.
